Question: Q008
Subject: PLA Metal: a metallic look and a metal-powder load in one material
Options: Keep them together as ruled; or split the metal-powder products into their own material
Why it matters: Ruling R039 filed Spectrum's PLA Metal Copper, Brass and Bronze under M011 PLA Metal, which holds Bambu's PLA Metal. The data now says they are not the same kind of product: Bambu publishes 1.25 g/cm3, a metallic colour effect, and Spectrum publishes 2.28 to 2.36, which is 60 to 70 per cent metal powder by weight. The material's density estimate is pulled to 2.17 and Bambu's own published value reads as an outlier against it. The same question will arise for wood, where a wood-effect PLA and a 30 per cent wood-flour one both exist.
